name: Network Tools
description: Network diagnostics: ping, DNS leak detection, local IP addresses, and TCP port checker.

slashCommands.title: Ping Host
slashCommands.description: Ping a hostname or IP address (4 packets, 3s timeout).

slashCommands.title: DNS Leak Test
slashCommands.description: Detect visible DNS resolver servers and show their IP, country, and provider.

slashCommands.title: Local IP Addresses
slashCommands.description: Show all active local IP addresses and adapter names.

slashCommands.title: Port Check
slashCommands.description: Check if a TCP port is open on a remote host.
